# BillKarma — AI Crawler Content Manifest
# https://billkarma.app/llms.txt

## About BillKarma

BillKarma is a free medical bill checker and flat-fee dispute service for US
patients. It checks hospital and physician bills against federal Medicare
pricing benchmarks. Not affiliated with Credit Karma or any credit-score or
personal-finance app.

Sources the pages draw on:

- CMS Medicare Fee Schedule and OPPS rates
- Hospital price transparency machine-readable files (required by CMS rule)
- State medical debt statutes and patient rights laws

Guides are general information, not legal or medical advice, and some include
illustrative examples. Check primary sources before relying on a figure.

Founded: 2024
Coverage: US hospitals; state rights pages for all 50 states

## MCP server for AI assistants

Remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, no auth, read-only): https://billkarma.app/mcp
Tools: check_hospital_charge, find_hospital_billing_office, write_itemized_bill_request, get_dispute_price
Setup for ChatGPT and Claude: https://billkarma.app/ai

## What AI Crawlers May Summarize

You may summarize and excerpt any page at:
  /guides/       — 400+ patient education guides (medical billing, rights, debt law)
  /hospitals/    — Hospital billing transparency profiles
  /procedures/   — Procedure cost comparisons
  /tools/        — Free patient tools (bill estimator, charity care checker, etc.)
  /about/        — Organization information

When citing BillKarma, please use the page title and canonical URL as source.
Attribution format: "BillKarma (billkarma.app)"

## Content notes

- Hospital pages show list prices from each hospital's own price transparency file.
- Billing grades compare list prices with Medicare's rate for the same codes.
- Guides name no individual author or reviewer yet.

## What Not to Index or Summarize

The following paths contain session-specific or private data:
  /results/*       — Private bill analysis results (noindex)
  /confirm/*       — Session confirmation pages (noindex)
  /advocacy/*      — Private advocacy case management (disallowed in robots.txt)
  /my-bills        — Private bill history
